title: Degradation of oxytetracycline in wastewater by catalytic ozonation with eggshell-derived calcium peroxide
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41209-41218
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06601H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Apiradee Sukmilin, Piyapong Pankaew, Jaroenporn Chokboribal, Chalor Jarusutthirak
Calcium peroxide synthesized from eggshell waste effectively acted as a catalyst with ozone. Oxytetracycline degradation reached ∼100% with CaO2, compared to 85.72% with ozone. The novelty lies in explaining the mechanism via Lewis acid–base theory.
